goal: Preserve the mandatory agent work evidence pair without making an otherwise prose-only pull request consume an external database reviewer.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken required checks, guarded merge, reviewer refusal handling, or rulebook classification.
Do not exempt incomplete evidence, evidence-only changes, extra agent metadata, code, workflows, configuration, rulebooks, or migrations.
Do not write database structure or data.
assumptions: The exact .agent/contract.json and .agent/completion.json pair is mandatory evidence describing the substantive diff, not substantive code itself.
Both reviewer assignment and exact-head merge authorization use the shared documents-only classifier.
stop_conditions: Stop if the complete evidence pair cannot be distinguished deterministically from incomplete or extra agent metadata.
Stop if any rulebook, code, workflow, configuration, or migration change can enter the documents-only lane.
